notes: Corrected the flagged three-morpheme unit לְבַדּוֹ → only, on the same ground as 1SA.7.3: rule 30 fuses the preposition with its construct noun but expressly keeps a pronominal suffix out of that fusion, and the ASV writes no pronoun for this suffix, the object of served being the written name.
The did of did put away is the finite verb's emphatic auxiliary (rule 17) and away completes a lexeme put alone does not write (rule 44).
